# ctyun_ecs_backup_policy_bind_instances (Resource)
-> 管理云主机和备份策略的绑定关系



## Example

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ctyun = {
      source = "ctyun-it/ctyun"
    }
  }
}

# 可参考index.md，在环境变量中配置ak、sk、资源池ID、可用区名称
provider "ctyun" {
  env = "prod"
}

resource "ctyun_ecs_backup_policy_bind_instances" "test" {
  policy_id        = "a4b793881bbd42edaa6a0002900e5819"
  instance_id_list = "ae432721-61bf-45b7-b207-7e3256c1c2d6"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id_list` (String) 云主机ID列表，多台使用英文逗号分割
- `policy_id` (String) 云主机备份策略id

### Optional

- `region_id` (String) 资源池ID，如果不填则默认使用provider ctyun中的region_id或环境变量中的CTYUN_REGION_ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID
## 导入

使用以下语法支持导入：

```shell
# 导入ECS备份策略绑定实例
# [] 标记的参数为必填参数
# <> 标记的参数为可选参数,不填则取值环境变量值
terraform import ctyun_ecs_backup_policy_bind_instances.example [policy_id],[instance_id_list],<region_id>
# 示例
terraform import ctyun_ecs_backup_policy_bind_instances.example 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012,"87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321,98765432-8765-8765-8765-543210987654",bb9fdb42056f11eda1610242ac110002
```
